answers.name: Circle

answers.name: Rectangle

answers.name: Oval
answers.fact: An egg-like curve.

answers.name: Star

answers.name: Heart

answers.name: Cube

answers.name: Sphere

answers.name: Cylinder
answers.fact: Like a tin can.

answers.name: Cone

answers.name: Pyramid

answers.name: Prism
answers.fact: Same cross-section all the way through.

answers.name: Ellipse
answers.fact: A stretched circle; planets orbit in them.

answers.name: Crescent
answers.fact: The shape of a thin moon.

answers.name: Nonagon

answers.name: Decagon

answers.name: Tetrahedron

answers.name: Octahedron
answers.fact: Eight triangular faces.

answers.name: Icosahedron

answers.name: Cuboid
answers.fact: A box shape.

answers.name: Torus

answers.name: Polygon

answers.name: Arrow
answers.fact: A pointer shape.

answers.name: Cross

answers.name: Spiral

answers.name: Quadrilateral

answers.name: Hemisphere

answers.name: Hendecagon

answers.name: Rhomboid

answers.name: Deltoid

answers.name: Annulus
answers.fact: A ring shape.

answers.name: Parabola
answers.fact: The curve of a thrown ball.

answers.name: Hyperbola

answers.name: Trefoil

answers.name: Lune

answers.name: Sector

answers.name: Frustum

answers.name: Pentagram

answers.name: Hexagram
answers.fact: A six-pointed star.

answers.name: Möbius strip
answers.fact: A surface with only one side.

answers.name: Reuleaux triangle
answers.fact: A curved triangle with the same width all round.

answers.name: Klein bottle
answers.fact: A bottle with no inside or outside.

answers.name: Gömböc
answers.fact: A Hungarian shape that always rights itself.

answers.name: Tesseract
answers.fact: A four-dimensional cube.

answers.name: Apeirogon
answers.fact: A polygon with infinitely many sides.

answers.name: Squircle
answers.fact: Halfway between a square and a circle, like an app icon.
